question: In India, the first National Basketball Championship was organised in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1934**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **first National Basketball Championship** in India was organized in the year **1934**. It marked the formal beginning of competitive basketball in the country. 
• The championship was aimed at promoting basketball as a sport and establishing its popularity across India. 
• Basketball had gained traction globally by the early 20th century, and India joined the trend by organizing its own competitive events. 
• The event laid the foundation for structured basketball tournaments and leagues in India, paving the way for more organized sports culture. 
• This initiative was crucial in introducing modern basketball rules and standards to Indian players and audiences, ensuring alignment with international norms.
